description: Source code implementing the PBCH encoder logic for 3GPP 5G NR, including payload generation, scrambling, CRC attachment, channel coding, and rate matching.

classes.name: pbch_encoder_impl
classes.description: Implementation class for PBCH encoding in 5G NR, handling payload generation, scrambling, CRC, channel coding, and rate matching.

methods.name: payload_generate
methods.description: Generates the payload bits for PBCH encoding based on message content.

methods.name: scramble
methods.description: Applies scrambling to the payload bits using a sequence generated based on message parameters.

methods.name: crc_attach
methods.description: Calculates and attaches CRC checksum to the payload bits.

methods.name: channel_coding
methods.description: Performs interleaving, channel allocation, and polar encoding on the data bits.

methods.name: rate_matching
methods.description: Performs rate matching to produce the final encoded output.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Main function to encode a PBCH message into a final bitstream.
